sentences.en: I don't like sewing because I can't thread the needle.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢缝纫，因为我穿不过针。

sentences.en: He seems to have lost the thread of the story.
sentences.zh: 他似乎已经搞不清故事的情节了。

sentences.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
sentences.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，穿不过针。
